title: Fix false return-to-live when a freshly-loaded page is too short to overflow the viewport
action: User field-test finding (2026-07-28): after cell -7 fixed multi-page paging for real, user reported page-down 'stops midway, less responsive than page-up, sometimes jumps back to live on its own, not felt as caused by the down button'. Root cause: now that real Claude Code pages are confirmed to vary in length hop to hop (non-monotonic, cell -7), a page short enough not to overflow the viewport means nudge-up's own scrollTop=0 jump-to-top ALSO reads as 'distance from bottom <= threshold' (nothing to scroll) -- the shared scroll listener's bottom-threshold-resume branch mistook this for a genuine return-to-live drag, silently resetting historyDepth to 0 and resuming poll mid-browse, matching the reported symptom exactly (a reset the user never triggered via the down button). Two changes: (1) the passive drag-to-bottom heuristic in the scroll listener now also requires scrollTop to be meaningfully away from the top (> HISTORY_SCROLL_THRESHOLD) before considering distance-from-bottom at all -- a genuine return-to-live (drag or nudge-down's own jump) always leaves scrollTop there, so this costs nothing for real returns. (2) nudge-down and applySheetInset (opening Reply/Keys, D6) no longer rely on that shared heuristic at all for their own explicit user-triggered return-to-live -- they call a new returnToLive() helper directly, since an explicit action shouldn't depend on an ambiguous scroll-position inference that can fail on short content.

truths: a short (viewport-fitting) loaded page never triggers the bottom-threshold return-to-live heuristic on its own
nudge-down and opening Reply/Keys always return to live regardless of the currently-loaded page's length
the passive drag-to-bottom heuristic still resumes poll promptly for a genuine return-to-live drag

artifacts.substantive: returnToLive() helper called explicitly by nudge-down and applySheetInset; scroll listener's bottom-threshold branch gated on scrollTop > HISTORY_SCROLL_THRESHOLD

new regression test for the short-page false-positive; updated the poll-resume-after-history-load test to explicitly return to live via nudge-down instead of relying on jsdom's default zero-sized layout

key_links: returnToLive() is the single place that clears viewingHistory/historyDepth and resumes poll for an explicit user action
prohibitions: no change to the escape-injection/multi-page backend logic (cells -1..-7)
